rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.

summary: Fresh sequential deck read across all 14 chunks (chunk 0 lede + 13 `##` sections) against all 11 check_slides.md rules, verified directly against current file content rather than trusting the prior instance record. Both issues the prior audit flagged are confirmed fixed on disk: rule 1's chunk-7 'the lock-it-in convention' phrasing is gone, replaced by a plainly explained mechanic ('the plan file is the artifact you're walking, and edits to it stay locked while you're in plan mode'); and rule 7's chunk-9 'Approve when it's yours. Not Claude's, not the second read's.' paired-negation tic is now 'Approve when it reads like your plan' — the prior instance's fix_hint applied verbatim. The new chunk 3 ('The plan is the one you read whole', lines 34-38) got full-depth scrutiny as directed: its line 'M1 named the countermove: never let the agent say everything, take the ranked list first' was traced against M1's actual body — `getting-going.md` (M1) includes `lectures/the-machine-you-just-met.md`, which does teach exactly this countermove, bolded at its naming moment ('Never let the agent say everything') — so the referenced beat is real, not stranded (rule 3 clears). The M1 reference itself unpacks its claim in the same sentence (matching the compendium's own passing pattern) and 'M1' as a module name is arc-earned spine vocabulary once a student has completed Module 1, so rule 2's cross-file-callback bar is also clear; module include-order confirms M2 (this file's host, `plan-mode-done-right.md`) runs after M1. The 2026-07-09 emphasis pass was independently re-checked bullet-by-bullet against the emphasis-budget rule: the Time/What-you-do/What-you-build/The-point/What-happened bold labels are confirmed structural chrome shared verbatim by every exercise file in the library (checked three siblings), not slide-content leads; the three push-back axis names, the 'keep planning with feedback' approval path, and the two coined-term/law handles ('Plan-mode approval inflation', 'Find is easier than judge') are each narrowed to a short handle landing at its naming moment; blockquote callouts are untouched. No chunk exceeds budget. Also swept the whole body fresh for LLM-cadence tics (Not-X-Not-Y constructions, anaphora triples, self-grading superlatives, number+retraction hedges, abstraction-noun stacks, empty verb-triplet legs) and internal dialect terms — none survive; the sole remaining triple-list ('every step, every file name, every verification' at chunk 3) is a single-sentence enumeration of three genuinely distinct concrete items, not the templated-clause-repetition tic the rule targets, and 'the slot' (chunk 7, unglossed) reads as ordinary training-time idiom consistent with 'the clock' used the same way one chunk earlier. Rule 10 (deck presence) and rule 11 (Phase 1-5 numbering, consecutive, every in-file reference resolving) both confirmed clean. Rule 4 stays N/A — no guess-before-reveal demo beats in this exercise. Nothing blocking, nothing TODO: verdict flips from the prior REVISE to PASS.
